source.title: Household Consumption Expenditure Survey 2023-24, NSS Report No. 592
source.publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
source.statements: Statement 3R (rural, pages S4-S9) and Statement 3U (urban, pages S10-S15): break-up of monthly per capita consumption expenditure over broad categories of consumption items by State/UT
source.method: Layout text of PDF pages S4-S15 parsed by scripts/extract-hces-item-groups.cjs; a dash (no sample reported) is stored as 0. Checks: food items sum to food total, non-food items to non-food total, and food + non-food to total MPCE, within print rounding.
source.licence: Government statistical publication; link and attribute NSS Report 592, Statements 3R/3U.

observations.state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
